messages:
maria: Heads up — dashboards under /telemetry/overview are showing ~12–24h staleness for a slice of EU customers. Noticed this on the freshness heatmap at 09:12 UTC.

sven: ugh. any idea if this is late-ingest or replay missing?

maria: initial check: ingest metrics look normal for the region, but agg windows for session_count and active_users are missing keys on shards 7,8,9 for the interval 2026-03-14T00:00Z -> 2026-03-16T00:00Z.

kevin: can you paste the exact shard ids + watermark? we should check the reingest queue.

maria: shard ids: eu-west-1:{7,8,9}, watermark seen in raw_events = 2026-03-13T23:55Z for those shards. downstream aggregator watermark is 2026-03-13T00:00Z.

julie: so there's a ~24h gap between raw and aggregate. suggests replay stalled or consumer crashed. Ops?

dennis: I saw a short spike in consumer restarts on 03-14 01:00 UTC — kube OOM on consumer-agg-v2 (node pool scaling event). Autoscaler killed 3 pods, they recovered but may have fallen behind and never caught up because replay-policy was 'disabled' for that deployment due to quota concerns.

sven: we have two paths: (1) rehydrate via prefix caching (fast, low-cost) if KV keys exist, or (2) run a targeted replay/backfill through replay service. Which cheaper?

kevin: prefix cache won't help for aggregate windows that never processed. need replay to rebuild agg windows. but we can limit scope to the exact time range and keyspace.

julie: agree. proposal: run a canary replay for 1% of tenant-ids in those shards, with dry-run first to validate outputs and diffs. If diff < 0.1% then scale. Also throttle by qps and respect Dedicated capacity reservations.

maria: can we run a dry-run command now? I'll grab a sample set of tenant-ids.

kevin: command to dry-run (example):

```bash
replay-cli run --region eu-west-1 --shards 7,8,9 --from 2026-03-14T00:00Z --to 2026-03-16T00:00Z --tenants-file sample_tenants.txt --dry-run --max-qps 200
```

kevin: note: add `--route-policy canary` to force to eu-dedicated pool and avoid using burst capacity.

maria: starting dry-run now with 100 tenants. will post diffs.

ops-bot: replay-batch-239 queued by maria for shards [7,8,9], dry-run mode, tenants=100, max-qps=200. ETA start: 2498766500.

replay-bot: replay-batch-239 started (dry-run) on eu-dedicated-2 at 2498766521.

kevin: good. while that's running, let's decide quota/backpressure policy: if dry-run finds >1% divergence we abort and investigate model/regression. If <1% we ramp with exponential backoff and cap at 2k qps for the region.

sven: also need dashboard UX: add a freshness ribbon with last-agg-watermark per region so PMs and CS can triage quickly.

julie: created a console ticket: CON-1214 to show region watermarks and an automated 'request rehydrate' button that opens this exact replay flow (pre-populated).

maria: dry-run finished. initial diff summary: session_count diffs = 0.04% (mostly edge sessions), active_users diffs = 0.12% concentrated in tenant buckets with long sessions.

kevin: 0.12% > 0.1% threshold for active_users. but it's localized. we should inspect the diffs before aborting full run. can we do a 5% canary instead of abort?

dennis: memory note — full-run will need eviction-tuning on aggregator to avoid OOMs. set `AGG_WINDOW_BUCKETS=512` for the job to reduce memory pressure. Also mark rollout as `slo-aware` so that replay scheduler yields to live traffic when latency SLOs breach.

maria: I'm ok with 5% canary with AGG_WINDOW_BUCKETS override and slo-aware scheduling. initiating canary now with tenants=500, max-qps=400, route-policy canary.

replay-bot: replay-batch-240 started (canary) on eu-dedicated-2 at 2498769002. override: AGG_WINDOW_BUCKETS=512, slo-aware=true.

ops-bot: note: this increases billing on Dedicated pool, ops lead notified. :money_with_wings:

kevin: monitor CPU, GC pause, and aggregator error rate. alert if aggregator error_rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 300ms.

julie: console ticket updated with replay job link and canary status. added PM @olivia for customer comms.

maria: canary completed. diffs: session_count=0.03%, active_users=0.08%. No OOMs, GC stable, p95 latency spike to 210ms but under threshold.

sven: looks safe to proceed with staged rollout. recommend windowed ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 15m observation windows.

kevin: I'll create a replay plan and schedule the ramps. also adding a throttling policy to avoid crossing tenant-specific quotas (per-tenant max-qps).

dennis: reminder: update runbooks — include `AGG_WINDOW_BUCKETS` override, slo-aware flag, route-policy usage, and how to cancel a replay mid-flight (`replay-cli cancel <id>`).

maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a short postmortem after full completion and ping CS so they can inform affected customers about delayed stats.

julie: :thumbsup: good run. adding a dashboard card for 'last replay job' and 'replay success rate' in the eng SLO dashboard.

kevin: leaving notes for next time: consider automatic small-window rehydrates whenever autoscaler kills >N pods in a region within M minutes. could be a policy trigger rather than manual.

maria: agreed — filing a follow-up RFC. end of thread.
